1.

This writ petition is filed by the petitioner seeking following reliefs:-
"10.1.

That, this Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to issue suitable writ or writs to direct the respondent authorities to pay the compensation amount to the petitioner with due interest against her land whatever acquired by the respondent Neutral Citation 2023:CGHC:28741 authorities in Khasra No. 456/3 only about rakba 0.057 and not 0.109 hectare situated at Village Kakna, Tehsil Rajpur, District Balrampur- Ramanujganj, C.G. according to Right to Fair Compensation & Transparency in Land Sushma Ekka vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 10 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/107205551/

sentences.text: 1 Acquisition, Rehabilitation & Resettlement Act, 2013.

10.2. That, this Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to issue direction to the respondent authority to consider the representation of the petitioner and further direct to the respondent authority for demarcation the land of the petitioner and after demarcation, give compensation for the same amount of land that is acquired in the National Highway.
10.3 Any other relief/relief (s) which may deem fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case, may also be allowed.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner is the owner of land bearing Khasra No.
456/3 admeasuring 0.109 hectares.
The respondents while constructing and widening of the National Highway No. 343 in between Ambikapur to Ramanujganj-Gadwa has initiated land acquisition proceedings.
In the first notification issued in this regard, name of the petitioner was not mentioned.
However, in the subsequent notification which was issued under the provisions of Section 3A (1), name of the petitioner is mentioned at Serial No. 700.

As per his information, instead of 0.009 hectares of land, less land is being effected and therefore, petitioner had submitted a representation/application before the Land Acquisition Officer mentioning the factual position.

Based on the Neutral Citation 2023:CGHC:28741 representation/application of the petitioner,
Respondent No. 3/SDO (R), Balrampur issued a direction to the Respondent No. 4/Tehsildar, to submit demarcation report.
The direction was issued on 21.07.2023, however, till date, the demarcation report is not submitted.

He further submits that the petitioner has submitted an application before the Respondent No. 4/Tehsildar for demarcation of his land bearing Khasra No.
456/3 which was also not considered and therefore, the Respondent No. 3 & 4 be directed to conclude the proceedings of demarcation within specified period of time.
3. Counsel for the respective respeondents submits that in view of the limited prayer made by the counsel for the petitioner, they are having no objection.

As Initially, the decision is to be taken by the Respondent No. 3/S.D.O (R) who is the Land Acquisition Officer and the grievance of the petitioner is against the non-conclusion of the proceedings of demarcation by the Respondent No. 4/Tehsildar.

4. Considering the submissions of the Counsel for the petitioner, documents available in record of writ petition, without entering into the merits of the claims of the petitioner, this petition at this stage is disposed of directing the Respondents No. 3 to take a decision on the representation/application submitted by the petitioner dated 21.07.2023 in accordance with law,
expeditiously, preferably Neutral Citation 2023:CGHC:28741 within a further period of four months from the date of receipt of the order.

Respondent No. 4 is also directed to conclude the demarcation proceedings, if pending in Revenue Case No. 202212271900005/A-12/2023 expeditiously within a further period of three months.
